name: OneDrive sync engine
short_description: The OneDrive sync software on a computer that detects local and cloud changes and keeps files in both places identical, including chunked, resumable and differential uploads.

evidence.quote: There's a piece of software running on your computer called the OneDrive sync engine.
We treat the sync client as a transparent pipe.
The one-drive client hooks into the OS to present cloud files as local entries.
